ending_commit_note: The final commit is supplied in the handoff because embedding its own hash would be self-referential; no post-commit mutation is permitted.
fixture_counting_method: A refusal fixture is one row that must be refused: every assertRaises block that fired, every exhaustive table row whose expected answer is refusal, and every parity mutation that must produce a non-passing report. A positive fixture is one row that must be admitted. Rows are counted once per category, so a reused record can appear in more than one category.
forbidden_actions_not_performed: No effect executor, process supervision, model transport, policy engine, direct or governed runtime mode, owner authorization, broker provisioning or consumption, provider contact, benchmark, mint, witness operation, production installation, or V14-V18 action.
No historical or production evidence modification.

independent_oracle.method: The oracle declares the receipt and terminal contracts literally, including per-effect-classification process-exit and reconciliation policy. One test compares the implementation matrix with the oracle; every exhaustive test derives its expected answer from the oracle rows only.

known_limitations: No physical transport, direct runner, governed runner, shared effect executor, durable ledger, evaluator execution, or installed path exists in M1; every status above is bounded by that absence.
The authoritative reconciliation paths are pure precondition checkers. They cannot detect a later runtime that ignores the types, forges observations, or bypasses the effect substrate.
list_files scope, read_file line bounds, and run_command truncation semantics are defined here for the first time; a future executor must implement exactly these semantics or issue a new ADR.
Run ID minting, durable publication, and restart behaviour remain future obligations.
The repository M0 manifests and all historical or production evidence were not rewritten.

repair_findings.closure: ExperimentSpecification now binds a typed EvaluatorSpecification whose environment must equal the experiment environment, and its evaluator_identity must be reconstructible from that exact evaluator. TerminalManifest.validate_for_specification compares the terminal evaluator fingerprint with the experiment evaluator fingerprint in the same fingerprint domain, so every other evaluator is refused. ComparativeManifest.create and validate_for_specifications call that check for both runs, so accepted and rejected terminals inherit the exact binding. The evaluator component identity and the evaluator specification remain distinct records with explicit roles: the identity names the specification and is derived from its exact contents.
repair_findings.false_positive_reproduction: At 41942a3 an ACCEPTED TerminalManifest whose evaluator_specification_fingerprint belonged to an unrelated evaluator (different requirements, scope, test plan, and environment) passed validate_for_specification, because the terminal only checked the run and experiment-specification fingerprints.

repair_findings.closure: ModeDecision.validate_for_proposal and EffectReservation.validate_for_decision add a typed fail-closed reconciliation path proving the exact experiment specification, the exact proposal ID and fingerprint, that the proposal validates for the specification, the exact mode-decision fingerprint, that the decision validates against the same proposal, that the decision permits an effect, the exact effect-executor identity, and that the reservation state is still pre-start. Structural validation remains available and is documented as non-authoritative.
repair_findings.false_positive_reproduction: At 41942a3 a reservation restored from bytes replaced proposal_id, proposal_fingerprint, and mode_decision_fingerprint, recomputed its own reservation fingerprint, and still passed validate_for_specification because only the experiment fingerprint and executor identity were checked.

repair_findings.closure: EffectReceipt now binds the exact tool name, effect classification, typed tool request fingerprint, an optional typed ToolResult, and an optional typed execution-failure class. RECEIPT_STATE_MATRIX gains a result-channel policy and an effect-application state, and process-exit policy and reconciliation are resolved by lifecycle state together with effect classification: list_files, read_file, and write_file forbid process-exit data in every state, run_command requires it only for COMPLETED and allows it for FAILED, CANCELLED, and TIMED_OUT. Pre-effect states carry no result, REFUSED cannot claim an executed effect, COMPLETED must bind a successful typed result, FAILED must bind a failed typed result or a typed execution failure, AMBIGUOUS can claim neither completion nor a known successful result, partial-mutation states require reconciliation and forbid replay, and task acceptance stays absent. EffectReceipt.validate_for_causal_chain is the authoritative reconciliation and calls the exact request/result validation of the bound result.
repair_findings.false_positive_reproduction: At 41942a3 a COMPLETED read_file receipt was refused without a process exit code and accepted with a synthetic exit code 0, and no receipt bound a tool name, an effect classification, a typed request, or a typed result.

repair_findings.closure: Every result type implements a pure validate_for_request. ListFilesResult enforces the request entry limit, entry scope, deterministic sorted unique relative paths, and bound-reaching truncation. ReadFileResult enforces retained line bounds, byte count, truncation semantics, and refuses content for refused or failed outcomes. WriteFileResult requires bytes_written to equal the UTF-8 byte length of the exact requested content and the written-content fingerprint to equal the fixed-domain fingerprint of those bytes; any other fingerprint domain is refused structurally. RunCommandResult enforces the request output bound, bound-reaching truncation, and process-start semantics, and separates tool execution success from a zero command exit code. The authoritative receipt reconciliation calls these.
repair_findings.false_positive_reproduction: At 41942a3 a WriteFileRequest for six bytes was paired with a successful WriteFileResult claiming bytes_written=1 and an arbitrary content fingerprint in an attacker-chosen domain, because results only checked the request fingerprint domain.

repair_findings.closure: RunCommandRequest requires a non-empty argv, a non-empty argv[0], NUL-free bounded arguments, and an explicit argument array; a bare shell string is refused. No shell parsing or execution is added.

ToolGrammarSpecification and ToolGrammarEntry are strict machine-verifiable records binding the grammar schema and version, the four tool names, the exact request and result schema IDs and versions, the effect classifications, and the fingerprints of the exact machine-readable schema descriptors, plus a canonical grammar fingerprint. ExperimentSpecification embeds the grammar and requires its tool_grammar_identity to be reconstructible from those exact contents. CanonicalProposal.create and validate_for_specification prove that the request schema is present in that exact grammar, that the request version is permitted, that the cited grammar fingerprint is exact, and that the tool name and effect classification match the grammar entry. Parity compares the full grammar specification in A and B.
repair_findings.false_positive_reproduction: At 41942a3 the experiment tool grammar was an opaque IdentityReference content fingerprint that any of the four globally known requests could self-declare; no typed object proved which schemas, versions, effect classifications, or bounds the experiment had selected.

schema_version_decision.future_runtime_rule: A runtime must adopt these exact version-1 definitions before persistence or issue a new ADR and consistently increment the affected versions.
schema_version_decision.no_mixed_definition_can_deserialize: Exact-key deserialization refuses a pre-repair ExperimentSpecification (no tool_grammar or evaluator_specification), a pre-repair EffectReceipt (no tool binding, result channel, or effect application), and a pre-repair RunCommandResult (no process_started). A pre-repair WriteFileResult is refused by the fixed written-content fingerprint domain, and a pre-repair tool request is refused because its grammar fingerprint domain is not the grammar-specification domain.
schema_version_decision.reason: M1 still has no runtime or external persistence contract, every affected artifact is regenerated together, and the architecture document records that no pre-repair M1 object is accepted as authoritative.
